_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: You visit the earth and water it; you crown the year with bounty.
The earth is full of the goodness of God.
Ten were cleansed, and one turned back to give thanks.
We return to fall at Jesus' feet.
Remember the Lord, who led you through the wilderness into a good land.
We will not forget the hand that fed us.
Come, let us worship the Giver of every good gift.
We come with thankful hearts. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Come to the table heavy with the harvest, the bread that did not run out, the cup that overflows, the year crowned with God's good gifts.
We give you thanks, O God.
We come like the one of ten who turned back, who fell at Jesus' feet and could not stop praising.
We give you thanks, O God.
For God supplies the seed and multiplies it, gives bread for the eating and bread to share.
We give you thanks, O God.
And do not say, my own hand has won me this; every good thing is gift, and the Giver is good.
We give you thanks, O God.
So come with open hands and worship.
We give you thanks, O God. Thanks be to God!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: You crown the year with bounty; the fields overflow.
We give you thanks, O God.
One leper returned to fall at Jesus' feet.
We give you thanks, O God.
God gives the seed and multiplies the harvest.
We give you thanks, O God.
Come, let us worship the Giver of all good gifts.
We come with thankful hearts. Amen.
